lines: The new habit. The *plan.* The goal you were so excited about.
Now it's just the same thing, every single *day.*
No rush. No *applause.* No visible results.
Not when it gets hard. When it gets *boring.*
The people who win can work when it's *not.*
#Mastery lives on the other side of *boring.*
The athlete repeating the same drill for *years.*
The writer facing the blank page every *morning.*
The saver putting money away month after *month.*
It means you've made it further than most *people.*
You've reached the part where the real results get *built.*
It just doesn't look like magic *yet.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

cover.sub: This is where most people quit

post.title: It Got Boring? This Is the Real Test.
post.caption: Anyone can work when it's exciting. Winners work when it's not. 🔁
post.first_comment: What habit are you sticking with even though it's boring? 👇
